visual.general_description: Five stacked line plots sharing one horizontal axis (weeks 1 to 18 followed by months 3 and 6), each with a left axis labelled "weekly alcohol units" (ticks 0 to 100), a right axis labelled "metacognitive beliefs" (ticks 0 to 80), a solid line with diamond markers (QFS) and a dotted line with square markers (MC), and two dash-dot stepped vertical lines crossing the plots.
visual.detailed_description: Top to bottom there are five plots with no printed patient labels. The legend in the top plot names QFS as a solid line with diamond markers and MC as a dotted line with square markers. The left axis reads "weekly alcohol units" with ticks 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100 and the right axis reads "metacognitive beliefs" with ticks 0, 20, 40, 60, 80. The horizontal axis is labelled "weeks" with ticks 1 to 18 and then "months" with ticks 3 and 6. Two unlabelled dash-dot stepped vertical lines cross the plots, a left one and a right one, each stepping to a different horizontal place from plot to plot; they are consistent with the start and end of the treatment phase named in the caption, but the image does not say so. Before the left line both series are weekly points at a high, fairly flat level, and between the two lines both series generally trend downward. Isolated unconnected markers sit near the right end of each plot, after the second dash-dot line, at different horizontal places in different plots. In the top plot the metacognitive series declines over several weeks and then drops steeply, after which it sits at the lowest end of its axis, while the QFS series declines more gradually. In the second plot both series fall soon after the left line, with a brief upward spike in the later weeks before falling again. In the third plot the metacognitive series declines in steps over the weeks while QFS drops after the left line and stays low. In the fourth plot both series decline and then run together at a low level. In the bottom plot the metacognitive series declines gradually while the QFS series drops abruptly at the left line and then stays lower. No values were read from the markers and no week or tick positions are assigned to individual points.

visual.detailed_description: The legend at the bottom names Pre-treatment (black), Post-treatment (dark grey), 3 months follow-up (mid grey) and 6 months follow-up (white). Every bar has a printed numeric label above it, transcribed in the readings. In all six charts the pre-treatment bars are the tallest or among the tallest for most patients, and the later bars are lower for most patients. Several patients show a later bar higher than an earlier post-treatment bar, for example the 6 months follow-up bars of patient 3 in the Audit-C and Penn Alcohol Craving Scale charts and of patient 2 in the HADS - Anxiety chart. Y axes differ by chart: Audit-C 0 to 12, HADS charts 0 to 20, Penn Alcohol Craving Scale 0 to 25, Positive Alcohol Metacognitions 0 to 40, Negative Alcohol Metacognitions 0 to 20. In the Positive Alcohol Metacognitions chart some adjacent labels run together (18 and 18 for patient 1, 15 and 15 for patient 3, 12 and 12 for patient 5) but each remains readable. No patient names, dates or identifiers are printed.
